title: 13 years on, Delhi Police serve notice on Mamata Banerjee in 2013 protest case

ai.summary: Delhi Police served a notice on Mamata Banerjee in a 2013 case related to student protests over Sudipto Gupta's death in police custody in Kolkata, where activists gheraoed Banga Bhawan and the Planning Commission office.

facts.claim: Delhi Police served a notice on Mamata Banerjee
facts.quote: the Delhi Police on Monday served a notice on former West Bengal Mamata Banerjee in connection a case registered during the protest.

facts.claim: The case relates to gherao of Banga Bhawan and Planning Commission office
facts.quote: Case relates to gherao of Banga Bhawan and Planning Commission office in New Delhi by SFI activists protesting death of Sudipto Gupta in police custody in Kolkata

facts.claim: Sudipto Gupta died in police custody in Kolkata
facts.quote: death of Students’ Federation of India (SFI) leader Sudipto Gupto in police custody in Kolkata
Thirteen years after a major student agitation in New Delhi over the death of Students’ Federation of India (SFI) leader Sudipto Gupta in police custody in Kolkata
hundreds of SFI and Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) protesters stormed and gheraoed Banga Bhawan, the official West Bengal government guest house on Hailey Road.
On April 3, 2013, hundreds of SFI and Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) protesters stormed and gheraoed Banga Bhawan, the official West Bengal government guest house on Hailey Road.
Tensions escalated on April 9, 2013, outside the Planning Commission office, where the then West Bengal Finance Minister Amit Mitra and Ms. Banerjee had arrived for an official meeting.

facts.claim: Delhi Police registered a case on April 9, 2013
facts.quote: Following the incident, the Delhi Police registered a case at the Parliament Street Police Station on April 9 for allegedly obstructing public servants from discharging their duties.
